item_name: Rothco Thin Blue Line Flag Travel Mug
item_short_desc: Show your support for law enforcement with Rothco’s Thin Blue Line Flag Travel Mug. This travel mug holds 16 fluid ounces and is constructed with double-walled, stainless steel insulation to keep your beverages at the ideal temperature, whether hot or cold. The sleek design features the Thin Blue Line flag printed on the front, symbolizing respect and support for law enforcement officials. Its screw-off cap with a convenient flip-top makes it easy to sip on the go without spills.
description: Show your support for law enforcement with Rothco’s Thin Blue Line Flag Travel Mug. This travel mug holds 16 fluid ounces and is constructed with double-walled, stainless steel insulation to keep your beverages at the ideal temperature, whether hot or cold.
